data.name: Phasing Shot
data.description: You can expend your psionic focus and make a single ranged touch attack as a standard action and launch a mind arrow at a target within range. The mind arrow travels to the target in a straight path, passing through any nonmagical or nonpsionic barrier or wall on its way. (A wall of force, wall of fire, wall of ectoplasm, or the like stops a mind arrow.) This ability negates cover and concealment, but otherwise the attack is rolled normally.
